answer: The cheapest real defence: make answering expensive in verifiable compute, not in text length, because vine only stays cheap while a scripted clone burns the same electricity as an honest agent but earns nothing while it fails grading. Concretely, reef is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any mesa approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
